# Labelbox

> > Labelbox is an AI data factory platform providing data labeling, curation, and model evaluation tools with RLHF support, integrated with Alignerr expert network and EchoChain technology.

Labelbox offers a comprehensive training data platform for AI teams, featuring multimodal annotation capabilities (image, video, text, PDF, geospatial, medical), model-assisted labeling, and integrations with enterprise data systems like Databricks, Snowflake, and BigQuery. The platform supports both self-service and on-demand annotation services through its Alignerr marketplace.

## Key Topics

- RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback)
- Alignerr expert network
- Data labeling and annotation
- Model-assisted labeling and auto-labeling
- Multimodal data (image, video, text, geospatial, medical)
- Data curation and AI search
- LLM training and evaluation
- SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)
- Enterprise integrations (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery)
- Security compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
- Geospatial and medical imaging
- PDF and document annotation
- Model evaluation and training pipelines
- Data factory workflows

## Core Platform & Products

- [The data factory for AI teams](https://labelbox.com): Homepage: AI data factory with Alignerr expert network & EchoChain
- [Data labeling](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate): Data labeling platform with RLHF, SFT & multimodal annotation support
- [Data curation](https://labelbox.com/product/data-curation): Vector & traditional search, data exploration & curation platform
- [Task specific models](https://labelbox.com/product/task-specific-models): Task-specific models for model-assisted labeling & auto-annotation
- [About Labelbox](https://labelbox.com/company/about): Company overview: AI data engine platform & Alignerr marketplace

## Annotation Tools & Capabilities

- [Annotate Tasks](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/tasks): Multimodal annotation tasks: image, video, text, PDF, geospatial & audio
- [Multimodal Chat](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/chat): Multimodal chat annotation for LLMs with RLHF & human evaluation
- [Throughput Annotate](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/throughput): On-demand annotation services with expert workforce & automation
- [Geospatial Imagery Annotation](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/geospatial): GeoTIFF, COG & NITF annotation tool for geospatial AI applications
- [Medical Data Annotation](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/medical): Medical imaging & pathology scan annotation with RLHF support
- [PDF Document Annotation](https://labelbox.com/product/annotate/document): PDF & HTML document annotation with OCR & named entity recognition
